page.content:
Spanish appellation of Tempranillo, American oak, and reserva aging.

How Rioja connects

  • Topic: Old World wine — Rioja is Spain's flagship Old World aging appellation.
  • Topic: Oak aging — Rioja's crianza and reserva ranks are built on oak time.

What is Rioja?

Rioja is Spain's best-known table-wine name, an Old World DOCa that talks in crianzas and reservas rather than château rank.

Key threads lead to Old World wine and Oak aging.
